definitions.explanation: The gathering of crops; the crops that are gathered.
Something valuable obtained from an effort or experience.

examples.english: The overseas training was very fruitful. Not only did I learn new techniques, but I was also able to meet colleagues from around the world.

notes:
{収穫|しゅうかく} means harvest (literal) or gains/fruits of effort (figurative).

LITERAL USAGE:
- {収穫|しゅうかく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to harvest)
- {収穫|しゅうかく}⟦{期|き}→収穫期：21343_shuukakuki⟧ (harvest season)
- {収穫|しゅうかく}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (harvest yield)
- {収穫|しゅうかく}⟦{祭|さい}→収穫祭：noentry⟧ (harvest festival)

FIGURATIVE USAGE:
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{収穫|しゅうかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there were great gains)
- {収穫|しゅうかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧ (a trip with many rewards)

RELATED TERMS:
- {収穫|しゅうかく}: harvest (general term)
- ⟦{稲刈|いねか}り→稲刈り：05933_inekari⟧: rice harvesting
- ⟦{実|みの}り→実り：12270_minori⟧: fruition, harvest (also figurative)
